get.description: 200 only when the API can reach Postgres; Fly and Docker health checks hit this.

post.description: Exa web search for GEO series; only GEO-verified, eligible series come back.
Which of these accessions exist and pass the eligibility filter.
Search GEO for human bulk RNA-seq series that have NCBI raw counts.

patch.description: Record the user's question and the UI's working state so a reload restores them.

post.description:
Start downloading the given series in the background.

Returns at once with every dataset in the session; poll ``listDatasets`` until the ones
you asked for are no longer ``pending``. Each arrives ready, excluded or failed.

get.description: Every dataset in the session with its current status.
Short-lived download link for one stored file.

post.description:
Run the pipeline on a collected dataset in the background, one entry per contrast.

Poll ``listRuns`` until the status leaves ``running``. The counts must already be in
the session (``collectDatasets``) and the dataset must be ``ready``.

get.description:
The run page in one call: status, progress, report, the submitted design and a
signed URL for every stored file (valid for the life of the session).
Short-lived download link for one run output, e.g. ``report.json`` or ``figures/pca.png``.

post.description:
Compare finished runs in this session in the background.

Every member must be a run of this session that is no longer running; the comparison
itself decides which members it can pool and records the rest as excluded. Poll
``listComparisons`` or ``getComparison`` until the status leaves ``running``.

get.description: The comparison page in one call: status, report and signed URLs for its files.

post.description:
Stream Claude's search for datasets that answer the question (Server-Sent Events).

Events: ``thinking`` (delta), ``tool`` (name, input, summary), ``result`` (a
``DiscoveryResult``), ``error`` (message), ``done``. The question is recorded on the
session.

get.description: Whether Claude is configured, plus the schemas of the streamed payloads.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: tool: one line for the UI

AgentTypes.title: AgentTypes
AgentTypes.description:
Never returned with content; exists so the streamed payloads appear in the OpenAPI
schema and the generated client has types for them.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.description: result stands but must be read with these caveats (uncertain labels etc.)

error.title: Error
error.description: set when the pipeline stopped on an exception

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: sha256 over the counts file, annotation file, design and parameters; a cached run is only reused when it matches

context.title: Context
context.description: modal harmonized field values (tissue, cell_type, ...) over the samples used, for grouping runs that answer the same question

gene_expression.title: Gene Expression
gene_expression.description: per-sample values for the looked-up genes (only when DE ran)

why.title: Why
why.description: why this series can answer the question

case_hint.title: Case Hint
case_hint.description: which samples would be the case arm

control_hint.title: Control Hint
control_hint.description: which samples would be the control arm

CompareRequest.title: CompareRequest
CompareRequest.description: A QuerySet over runs in this session, plus the few parameters a user may set.

effective_min_studies.title: Effective Min Studies
effective_min_studies.description: min_studies actually applied (lowered when few datasets)

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: what a person must decide before trusting the pool

pooled_enrichment.description: GSEA preranked on the pooled z over genes with a symbol

Concordance.title: Concordance
Concordance.description:
Pairwise Spearman correlation of Wald statistics over genes tested in both runs.

``mean_to_others`` is each run's mean against the other runs of its concordance
group, leaving out runs flagged ``labels_reversed``.

blocking.title: Blocking
blocking.description: Sample field pairing case and control (e.g. 'donor'); recorded, not modelled

restricted_to.title: Restricted To
restricted_to.description: Sample field -> value the contrast is limited to, e.g. {'time_point': '24 h'}

status.title: Status
status.description: pending while downloading; poll until it moves

record.description: GEO metadata and checks; None while pending or when failed

design_status.title: Design Status
design_status.description: pending, then designing while Claude works; designed means its run was started, skipped means the contrast was not runnable, failed means no design

proposal.description: the contrast Claude chose, once the design step ran

design_error.title: Design Error
design_error.description: why the design was skipped or failed

n_case_used.title: N Case Used
n_case_used.description: observations fitted in the case arm (after collapsing)

gsms_fitted.title: Gsms Fitted
gsms_fitted.description: every GSM that contributed to the fit

collapsed.title: Collapsed
collapsed.description: fitted observation -> GSMs summed into it (repeated samples per block/arm)

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: why the contrast must not run; empty when runnable

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.description: caveats that travel with the result

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: choices the record left open and how they were made

validation_errors.title: Validation Errors
validation_errors.description: labels Claude could not back with evidence

DesignProposal.title: DesignProposal
DesignProposal.description:
The one contrast the agent chose for a dataset, with every reason to hesitate attached.
Nobody confirms it: ``problems`` empty means it runs, otherwise the dataset is skipped.

interpretation.title: Interpretation
interpretation.description: the question restated as a two-group comparison

clarifying_questions.title: Clarifying Questions
clarifying_questions.description: what must be decided before choosing datasets; empty when clear

GeneExpression.title: GeneExpression
GeneExpression.description: Per-sample log2 normalized counts for one queried gene, for the UI's strip plot.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: verdict differs from the full-set verdict

GeneLeaveOneOut.title: GeneLeaveOneOut
GeneLeaveOneOut.description: The same gene pooled without one dataset.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: label -> estimate, SE and padj in that dataset

driven_by.title: Driven By
driven_by.description: datasets whose removal changes the verdict

GeneLookupAcross.title: GeneLookupAcross
GeneLookupAcross.description: The direct answer to 'is gene X higher in case than control' across datasets.

GeneLookupRow.title: GeneLookupRow
GeneLookupRow.description: The direct answer to 'is gene X higher in case than control' for one dataset.

n_tested.title: N Tested
n_tested.description: datasets with a valid estimate and SE (pooled)

n_with_padj.title: N With Padj
n_with_padj.description: of those, datasets where DESeq2 reported a padj

n_agree_pooled.title: N Agree Pooled
n_agree_pooled.description: datasets whose sign matches the pooled direction

replication.title: Replication
replication.description: datasets significant in the pooled direction / n_tested

majority_disagrees_pooled.title: Majority Disagrees Pooled
majority_disagrees_pooled.description: most datasets point the other way from the pooled estimate

se_ci.title: Se Ci
se_ci.description: SE behind the interval and p-value

lfc_threshold.title: Lfc Threshold
lfc_threshold.description: top tables list robust genes with |pooled log2FC| >= this

matched_queries.title: Matched Queries
matched_queries.description: Which submitted queries found this series

mixed_organism.title: Mixed Organism
mixed_organism.description: True when the series also has non-human samples; they are excluded at fetch time.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: Role of a sample relative to the research question.

robust_retained.title: Robust Retained
robust_retained.description: share of robust genes still robust without it

concordance_group.title: Concordance Group
concordance_group.description: runs are judged against the others in this group

pooled.title: Pooled
pooled.description: contributes to the default pooled estimate

weight_share.title: Weight Share
weight_share.description: mean random-effects weight share over pooled genes

Member.title: Member

MemberEffect.title: MemberEffect
MemberEffect.description: One dataset's estimate for one gene, as the forest plot draws it.

left_out.title: Left Out

n_consistent.title: N Consistent

stratum.title: Stratum
stratum.description: sub-question this run answers (e.g. lesional_vs_healthy); runs are pooled overall and per stratum, and concordance is judged within a stratum

term.title: Term
term.description: Exact term sent to esearch, for provenance

total.title: Total
total.description: Series in GEO matching the term

Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.description: How the counts matrix columns lined up with the sample sheet and contrast.

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: true until the pipeline has started this contrast

RunProgress.description: Live view of a running contrast, rebuilt from the pipeline's progress lines.

genes.title: Genes
genes.description: symbols or GeneIDs to look up
